citation: Kent D, Stanley J, Aurora RN, et al. Referral of adults with obstructive sleep apnea for surgical consultation: an American Academy of Sleep Medicine clinical practice guideline. J Clin Sleep Med. 2021;17(12):2499-2505.
currencyNote: This guideline states that it replaces the previously published 2010 AASM surgical guideline and remains listed in the active AASM guideline index when verified on 2026-08-07.
bestFor: When adults with OSA may warrant discussion of sleep-surgery or bariatric-surgery referral, PAP intolerance/nonacceptance or inadequate adherence, and major upper-airway anatomic abnormalities.

mappingRationale.D4B: Directly addresses surgical consultation as an alternative or adjunctive OSA treatment pathway.

sections.label: Scope of surgical referral guidance for adult OSA
